facts.text: The hotel is a design-led lifestyle hotel inside a restored Art Deco landmark, a few steps from Wenceslas Square and the Old Town.
facts.excerpt: a design led lifestyle hotel inside a restored _**Art Deco**_ landmark, awarded _**One MICHELIN Key**_, _just few steps from **Wenceslas Square** and **the Old Town.**_

facts.text: The hotel was formerly the historic Alcron Hotel.
facts.excerpt: Almanac X Alcron Prague, formerly the historic Alcron Hotel

facts.text: Almanac X Alcron Prague has been awarded One MICHELIN Key by the MICHELIN Guide.
facts.excerpt: Almanac X Alcron Prague has been awarded One MICHELIN Key by the MICHELIN Guide

facts.text: The Alcron Hotel first opened in 1932, founded by architect Alois Krofta.
facts.excerpt: Our story began in 1932. It was then, thanks to the bold vision of our founder and architect Alois Krofta, that the doors of the Alcron Hotel first opened.

facts.text: The hotel's name was crafted from the initial letters of the founder's name, ALois KROfta, with inspiration from the mythical Greek ship Alcron.
facts.excerpt: its name crafted from the initial letters of his own name—ALois KROfta—while drawing inspiration from the mythical Greek ship Alcron

facts.text: Jazz legends Louis Armstrong and Ella Fitzgerald stayed at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Jazz legends Louis Armstrong and Ella Fitzgerald found their haven here.

facts.text: On the night of August 20, 1968, an Associated Press reporter sent the first urgent dispatch announcing the Warsaw Pact occupation of Czechoslovakia via the hotel teletype.
facts.excerpt: sent the world’s very first urgent dispatch via the hotel teletype, announcing that Czechoslovakia was being occupied by Warsaw Pact troops

facts.text: In March 2023 the former Alcron Hotel underwent an extensive renovation and reopened under a new concept as Almanac X Alcron Prague.
facts.excerpt: In March 2023, a new chapter began to unfold in the chronicle of our hotel.

facts.text: The interior design is by the Spanish studio Tres Cinco Uno in collaboration with the Czech Marani Studio.
facts.excerpt: The unique interior design was masterminded by the Spanish creative studio Tres Cinco Uno in collaboration with the Czech Marani Studio.

facts.text: The original rare wood paneling, marble details and historic fireplace were preserved in the lobby and restaurant.
facts.excerpt: The original rare wood paneling, marble details, and the historic fireplace were all carefully preserved in the lobby and restaurant.

facts.text: The room color palette reflects Prague: sandy tones of stone facades, brick red of Old Town terracotta roofs and green of the city's parks.
facts.excerpt: The interiors embrace you with the sandy tones of historic stone facades. These are complemented by a brick red that mirrors the terracotta roofs of the Old Town

facts.text: Every room and suite has unique original artworks.
facts.excerpt: Every room and suite harbors unique original works that perfect the unmistakable character and genius loci of each space.

facts.text: A monumental mural by Czech artist Lu Skrivankova is right behind the reception.
facts.excerpt: right behind the reception, a monumental mural by Czech artist Lu Skřivánková captures everyone’s attention

facts.text: The hotel's staircase features rotating art exhibitions.
facts.excerpt: Our iconic staircase features rotating exhibitions.

facts.text: The Presidential Suite offers a view of Prague Castle.
facts.excerpt: Experience a two-night stay in the Presidential Suite, offering a breathtaking view of Prague Castle.

facts.text: The Presidential Suite is adorned with hand-cut crystal objects from the Ruckl glassworks, and a stay package adds a visit to the manufactory to try glassmaking.
facts.excerpt: our Presidential Suite is adorned with hand-cut crystal objects from the legendary Rückl glassworks. With our special stay package, you can combine luxurious accommodation with an exclusive visit to the manufactory

facts.text: Alcron Bar is a cocktail bar that Studio Qubus turned into a 'Liquid Gallery' of design objects by Jakub Berdych Karpelis.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy our exclusive signature drinks in this art space filled with objects by Jakub Berdych Karpelis.

facts.text: Brasserie 1932 serves Czech cuisine brasserie-style.
facts.excerpt: Discover the best of Czech cuisine, brasserie-style.

facts.text: Elias Coffee Shop serves freshly roasted coffee from the hotel's own brand along with healthy snacks.
facts.excerpt: Savor the aroma of freshly roasted coffee from our own brand while ordering healthy snacks and treats

facts.text: The Alcron Rooftop terrace has a planned opening in 2026.
facts.excerpt: **Planned opening is 2026.** We are looking forward to the sunset views from our Prague rooftop.

facts.text: The Crystal Ballroom has a vaulted ceiling and a glass roof that brings in natural daylight.
facts.excerpt: featuring a soaring vaulted ceiling and a glass roof that floods the space with natural daylight

facts.text: The hotel has a sauna and a fitness center.
facts.excerpt: complimentary access to the sauna and fitness center

facts.text: The hotel showroom is under the direction of Linda Pro, merging Czech glassmaking tradition with innovative design.
facts.excerpt: a place where Czech glassmaking tradition seamlessly merges with innovative design

facts.text: The hotel hosts in-house events with local tastemakers, producers and artists.
facts.excerpt: Explore our in-house Almanac X Alcron Prague events with local tastemakers, producers, and artists

facts.text: The Alcron restaurant held a Michelin star until 2017.
facts.excerpt: This long-standing journey toward culinary perfection was officially crowned with a prestigious Michelin star, which the restaurant held until 2017.

facts.text: Director Milos Forman was a regular at the hotel bar, where the idea for his film Loves of a Blonde was born.
facts.excerpt: it was right here that the idea for his world-renowned film Loves of a Blonde was born

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler lists the hotel at Stepanska 623/40, Prague.
facts.excerpt: Štěpánská 623 /40, Prague, 110 00
